source.construction: Exact previously running image source plus only five modified source-file diffs, new supplier deletion service, and version-only changes in runtime package metadata; line endings normalized only in patch targets. Other local-main changes were not deployed.

supplierDeletion.permission: master.manage, an existing global maintenance permission; label explicitly includes deletion of unused suppliers. Default staff/supervisor/finance excluded; administrator or explicitly delegated maintainer allowed.
supplierDeletion.usedSuppliers: Refused in full, including draft-document references; suggest disabling. No contract cascade or document supplier-link removal.
supplierDeletion.unusedSuppliers: Remove supplier record and its aliases; leave other masters and business unchanged; audit original name/aliases, not extra contact-phone copies.
supplierDeletion.restore: No direct UI restoration; recreating same name creates a new ID.

projectImpact: Behavior unchanged: only administrators can delete projects without documents/contracts/revenues/upload batches; memberships of deleted project removed, employee accounts and other project permissions retained. Recreated project needs new role assignments.

employeeImpact.type: Logical deletion: active=false and deletedAt set; account omitted from list.
employeeImpact.sessions: Password login denied; previously issued session denied on next authenticated request. Already displayed content not remotely erased.
employeeImpact.history: Documents, revenues, approval records, actor attribution and audits retained; no automatic reassignment.
employeeImpact.memberships: Existing rows retained by employee deletion but ineffective while account deleted. Separate later project deletion may remove memberships of that project.
employeeImpact.wechat: Existing binding retained and not automatically unbound; later reuse requires handling old binding. OAuth integration still deferred.
employeeImpact.employeeNumber: Not reusable; deleted users cannot be reactivated through current PATCH UI/API.
employeeImpact.selfDeletion: Current login cannot be deleted. Temporary disabling can be re-enabled.

candidateBrowser.fixtureScope: Project and employee rows exist only in intercepted browser GET responses; no production fixtures or actual deletion. Supplier DELETE deliberately intercepted with 409 to check error/cancel UI.

publicBrowser.fixtureScope: Project and employee rows exist only in intercepted browser GET responses; no production fixtures or actual deletion. Supplier DELETE deliberately intercepted with 409 to check error/cancel UI.

validation.testBoundaries: Real SQL/service/route deletion and refusal tested in independent local test DB. Browser project/employee rows and supplier 409 responses intercepted only in browser. No actual production supplier or employee deletion attempted.

wechatUrlVerification.appealApproval: No new user confirmation received; previous proof-material stage remains last known state.

backupAndRecovery.policy: Continued user-requested launch-cleanup context with no new DB/image/private-env rollback backups. No DB/image restore. Prior application image and immutable tags retained.
backupAndRecovery.sourceArchive: Source/build inputs only, no credentials, DB dumps or business uploads.

githubSync.method: Separate sanitized fast-forward snapshot; original local history and original release tags not pushed. Completion receipts committed/synchronized afterward; latest remote main authoritative.
